## File: facebookresearch_aira-dojo/src/dojo/ui/components/exp_analysis.py

Prompts

```
['list all experiment folders within a meta experiment directory using the list_experiments function', 'recursively list files and folders in a directory up to a specified max depth', 'find all log files matching a glob pattern like *.jsonl in an experiment directory', 'generate basic statistics about a meta experiment including experiment counts and slurm log info', 'execute a utility script such as log_error_parsing or parse_tree_stats on experiment data']
```

Usage

```
{'list_experiments': 'list all experiment folders within a meta experiment directory using the list_experiments function', 'list_files_recursive': 'recursively list files and folders in a directory up to a specified max depth', 'find_log_files': 'find all log files matching a glob pattern like *.jsonl in an experiment directory', 'analyze_meta_experiment': 'generate basic statistics about a meta experiment including experiment counts and slurm log info', 'execute_utility': 'execute a utility script such as log_error_parsing or parse_tree_stats on experiment data'}
```
